question_text: A 12-year-old boy is brought in by his mother with a 2-day history of fever and generalized weakness. She says that her son was involved in a school fight with some other kids 4 days ago and sustained minor injuries to the face. He was otherwise well, until this morning, when he complained of pain in his right eye. Physical examination reveals periorbital erythema and edema of the right eye, along with ophthalmoplegia and proptosis. Which of the following findings will most likely be present in this patient on the affected side as a sequela of his current condition?
